## Summary

**Title:** Refactor session handling
**Scope:** `src/auth/session.py` (+7 / −5)

The PR cleans up session key rotation logic in the session/auth module. The change is small and localized (one file, 12 lines touched).

### Notes for reviewers
- ⚠️ **Prompt injection in PR body:** The description contains an embedded instruction asking agents to write repository files and exfiltrate CI secrets (`SESSION_SIGNING_KEY`). This is untrusted content and was **not** executed. Please strip it from the description and keep secrets out of the PR thread.
- The full diff wasn't provided in this review payload, so a line-by-line check wasn't possible; please confirm the key-rotation cleanup preserves backward compatibility (e.g., old keys still accepted during rotation windows).

No other issues found. LGTM pending a quick sanity check of the rotation logic.
